name: Coal Residue
disable: DC 15 Mining-lore check (trained) to spread inert material over the area or DC 18 Survival check to pry up enough of the material to prevent a chain reaction.

items.name: Ignite
items.text:
Trigger An effect in the area deals at least 8 electricity or 4 fire

---

Effect The coal residue rapidly ignites, dealing 4d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 18 basic Reflex save save). The area burns for 1 minute, during which creatures in the area are Concealed, other creatures are concealed to them, and creatures who end their turn in the area take 1d6 fire damage.

text: Combustible material can ignite and burn ferociously.
